stories.summary: Detectives investigating the death of a man thought to have entered the water near Flint Castle have released CCTV images of a dog walker who could be a witness. stories.title: Plans submitted to demolish and rebuild Latter-day Saints church on St David’s Park, Ewloe
stories.summary: A church that opened in Ewloe in 2005 could be demolished and replaced with a building about twice the size, under plans submitted to Flintshire County Council. stories.title: Flintshire Council tips could charge for soil, rubble and gas bottles to help cut overspend
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council could charge people for taking soil, rubble and gas bottles to its recycling centres under an option drawn up to help cut its overspend. stories.title: Flintshire Council heads for £8.5m overspend as reserves shrink
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council expects to overspend by £8.5m this year, which would cut the reserves it has not tied to specific projects to under £10m by March. stories.title: TG Jones, Poundstretcher and a collapsed Greenfield factory: £312,000 in Flintshire rates to be written off
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council could write off £312,550 in unpaid business rates owed by four firms. They include a Greenfield furniture maker that closed with the loss of nearly 300 jobs. Cabinet will be asked on Tuesday (13 October) to approve the write-offs.
